q: The proximal relation P in a topological dynamical system: x P y if inf_{n≥0} d(Tⁿx, Tⁿy) = 0. In a distal system (no two distinct proximal points), the Ellis semigroup E(X) is:
opts: A semigroup with a zero element
exp: Distal systems: E(X) is a group. This is because in a distal system, every element of E(X) is bijective (invertible). The structure theorem for distal systems (Furstenberg) builds them as towers of isometric extensions.
